What it does: How fast the item moves: meters per second in 3D (4 to start), pixels per second in 2D (200 to start).
How fast the item turns, in degrees per second (120 to start).
How high the item jumps when Space is pressed: meters in 3D, pixels in 2D.
How quickly the item speeds up and slows down. 0, the start, means at once.
TURN_AND_MOVE turns with left and right. CAMERA_RELATIVE moves relative to the camera. FLY adds E and Q for up and down.
TOP_DOWN moves in every direction. SIDE_VIEW moves left and right and jumps, like a platform game.
Changes which key does what. Each command can also have extra keys added.
